Pride and Prejudice was written by Jane Austen. The novel was published in 1813 (though Austen originally titled it *First Impressions* and drafted it in the late 1790s, it was heavily revised before its eventual publication). It's widely considered a masterpiece of English literature and one of the most beloved novels of all time, known for its wit, social commentary, and exploration of love, class, and marriage in Regency-era England.
